Bible 365

🔍
How Bible 365 works

The whole Bible in 365 days. Your Day 1 was the day you started — the calendar moves whether you read or not, so today's number is your place in the year, not your page count.

Each day is one reading: a theme and a passage. Open it, read it, mark it read.

Missed days stay open behind you. Go back and complete them any time — your streak counts consecutive days you actually finished.

Every book, every chapter, open whenever you want. This is your Bible to read freely, at your own pace, with no calendar and no streak.

Tap a verse to highlight it or leave a private note. Your highlights, your notes, and the spot you left off are saved to you and follow you across devices.

Stuck on a passage? Ask The Steward's Bible Buddy. It answers with scripture and context only, never opinions, so you can go deeper and stay in the Word.
